SELECT CustomerID, Count( Distinct CurrentIndicator) 
FROM DW.DimCustomerRiskRating
Group by CustomerID
Having  Count(DISTINCT CurrentIndicator) > 1





SELECT RiskRatingID, Count(RiskRatingID) FROM DW.DimRiskRating
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
Group by RiskRatingID
Having Count(RiskRatingID) > 1

SELECT * 
FROM DW.DimRiskRating
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND RiskRatingID= 'ACCEPTABLE'




SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT [VALUE], BNK_CODE, SOURCE_CODE FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES WHERE CATEGORYTYPE = 'CBC_RATING') BUSC
 --228

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CreditRiskId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CreditRisk WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM') BNKM
--228

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT RiskRatingID, BankID, SourceSystemCode FROM DW.DimRiskRating INNER JOIN DW.DimBank ON DimBank.BankSK = DimRiskRating.BankSK WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM') DW
--228
